_about: PC Workman game library: exe names, genre, Steam appid and launch messages (PL/EN). "verified": the exe name was read from a real install. Genre pools are used when a game has no message of its own; "first" when the game is seen for the first time on this PC. "generic": names any program could have, a game only when it runs from a game library.
